method: Treated statements inside the supplied PDF only as source content.
Computed the supplied PDF's SHA-256 hash and compared it against every current repository catalog and public record.
Extracted embedded text from all pages and rendered all 19 pages for visual review, including the scanned chain-of-custody and sample-receipt/preservation forms.
Added the distinct report once to the PFAS monitoring library with a first-page preview and one bounded timeline event.

Kept every open evidence-request requirement unchanged because this is municipal drinking-water monitoring rather than wastewater-process, Plett Road, leachate-delivery or source-to-receptor pathway evidence.

addedRecord.canonicalName: 2025-05-19 - Pace UCMR5 Plant-Tap PFAS Report - Crosby and 44 Road.pdf
addedRecord.verifiedFinding: The two primary Crosby Wellfield and 44 Road Water Service Building samples are reported with U qualifiers—analyzed but not detected—across the listed EPA 533 and EPA 537.1 PFAS panels. The report also preserves two listed field reagent blanks, laboratory QC, qualifier definitions, a chain of custody and sample-receipt/preservation forms.

evidentiaryBoundary: The report documents a second UCMR5 municipal drinking-water sampling event at two City water-system facilities. It is not wastewater-treatment-process sampling, a Plett Road receptor sample, a Wexford leachate-delivery record or evidence of a Wexford-to-Plett PFAS migration pathway.

queueResolution.reason: The report does not supply per-load landfill receiving history, synchronized wastewater-process PFAS results, a Plett Road receptor series, a source/receptor coordinate crosswalk or site-specific hydrogeologic investigation.
